name: ghost-windows
description: Local-first MCP memory server for Claude Code on native Windows: one SQLite file, hybrid search, automatic consolidation. Each archive bundles one native ghost.exe; install the marketplace entry for this PC's architecture (ghost-windows-amd64 for most PCs, ghost-windows-arm64 for Windows on ARM). Without the plugin, install the standalone binary from install.ps1 and run `ghost mcp init`.
